OF ASSAM  HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE DEPARTMENT  DISPUR  GUWAHATI 06  4:THE SELECTION SUB COMMITTEE  REPRESENTED BY ITS CHAIRPERSON  COMMISSIONER  FOOD SAFETY AND DRUGS CONTROL ADMINISTRATION  ASSAM DISPUR  GUWAHATI 06  5:SRI HIMANGSHU PRATIM NATH  RESIDENT OF VILLAGE BARBHAGIA  Page No.# 2/2  PO CHARAIBAHI Himangshu Sarma vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 23 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188620478/ 
1  DIST MORIGAON  ASSAM 78210 Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. A J DAS Advocate for the Respondent : GA, ASSAM  BEFORE  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE LANUSUNGKUM JAMIR  ORDER 23.02.2024 Heard Mr. A.J. Das, learned counsel for the petitioner. Issue notice. 
Mr. B. Gogoi, learned Standing Counsel, Health Department appears for respondent Nos.1 to 4.
Petitioner to take steps for service of notice upon respondent No.5 by registered post with AD within a week from today.
List the matter after four weeks. Appointment of respondent No.5 as Registrar, Assam Pharmacy Council by Notification dated 07.02.2024 shall be subject to the outcome of the writ petition. 
Learned Standing Counsel, Health Department shall also produce the records on the next returnable date.
